title: Home Made Electronic Arts: Do-it-yourself Pirate TV, Noise Generators and Video Machines

description.main: A bilingual German and English guide to do-it-yourself electronic art, edited by Dominik Landwehr and Verena Kuni and published by Christoph Merian Verlag in 2009. It covers pirate TV, noise generators and video machines.
description.extended:
A handbook of homemade electronic art, edited by Dominik Landwehr and Verena Kuni, that treats pirate television, noise generators and video machines as things to be built rather than bought.

The book appeared in 2009 from Christoph Merian Verlag, with the Migros-Kulturprozent named on the cover. It is a 192-page paperback printed in German and English. The two-language title reads Do-it-yourself Pirate TV, Noise Generators and Video Machines and Do-it-yourself Piratensender, Krachgeneratoren und Videomaschinen. The cover shows a printed circuit board in black on white, with the title on a yellow band.

Landwehr and Kuni edited a companion volume in 2013, Home Made Bio Electronic Arts, covering microscopes, sensors and sound experiments, also from Christoph Merian Verlag.

notes: Series companion: Home Made Bio Electronic Arts (Christoph Merian Verlag, 2013, ISBN 9783856165673). The cover image reads "Piratensender, Krachgeneratoren und Chaos-Lichter / Pirate Radio, Noise Generators, Chaos-Lights", while retail listings under this ISBN give "Videomaschinen / Video Machines" in the subtitle, so a second printing or cover variant may exist; check the copy. Page count differs by source (192 in most listings, 160 in one, 128 in another). The publisher link goes to a retail record. Identified from a spine photograph; edition not checked against the copy.
